hook.name: hook
hook.reason: The mother touching a scarred man's face and saying 'I buried you' immediately establishes a powerful emotional premise of resurrection and grief.

narrative_tension.name: narrative_tension
narrative_tension.reason: Tension builds as the mother questions his survival, leading into the revelation of a classified military betrayal, though it unfolds primarily through exposition rather than escalating conflict.

cliffhanger.name: cliffhanger
cliffhanger.reason: Ending on a firm 'Yes' confirms the existence of the traitor, leaving the audience hanging on the identity and the deeper conspiracy.
cliffhanger.open_question: Who is the traitorous British officer, and why was Alexander left for dead?

context_independence.name: context_independence
context_independence.reason: The core relationship (mother and supposedly dead son) and the immediate stakes (uncovering a military conspiracy/betrayal) are entirely self-explanatory.
context_independence.blind_summary: A mother is shocked to discover her son Alexander, whom she believed died in a destroyed military regiment three years ago, is actually alive. Alexander then begins to explain that his survival stemmed from a classified Crown mission investigating a traitorous British officer.

confusions.issue: Who 'they' are who falsely reported Alexander's death and regiment destruction is left unspecified.
The specific identity of the British officer selling secrets is not revealed.

curiosity_gap.name: curiosity_gap
curiosity_gap.reason: The clip sets up a compelling military mystery and emotional reunion while withholding the identity of the traitor and the conspirators.
revealed: Alexander survived a regiment-destroying mission he wasn't supposed to make it out of
The mission involved investigating a British officer selling secrets to French spies
withheld: Who ordered the cover-up of his regiment's destruction

emotional_impact.name: emotional_impact
emotional_impact.reason: The mother's tearful disbelief and anguish over believing her son was dead creates strong emotional resonance.

archetype.note: archetype 'mystery_relevation' is not in the taxonomy

stakes.value: A presumed-dead soldier returns to expose a high-level military betrayal and uncover the truth behind his faked death.

curiosity_revealed: Alexander survived a regiment-destroying mission he wasn't supposed to make it out of
The mission involved investigating a British officer selling secrets to French spies
curiosity_withheld: Who ordered the cover-up of his regiment's destruction
promo_dna.appeal: A supposed war casualty returns home to expose a dangerous military conspiracy and uncover a traitor.
